tags.name: Cohorts
tags.description: How Cohort Reports are archived/built:  A cohort is a group of visitors whose first visit was within a specific period. Cohort reports show metric values for each cohort for periods after the cohort's first visit.  Archiving:  We only archive one type of record: blobs that aggregate metrics by the day of first visit. This involves a simple query on the log_visit and log_conversion tables.  When aggregating for non-day periods, we can just aggregate the records for the individual days. Ie, the visits for week X for cohort that started on day N, is the sum of visits for each day in week X, for the same cohort.  The records are transformed in the API methods.  API:  The records, which show metrics by first day of visit, are transformed into reports that show metrics by the period of the first visit.  We basically transform the label of the record (the date of first visit) to the requested period type, and group rows w/ the same label together. We also remove any rows that are outside of the requested periods.  After this, we modify the report the required format. For the Cohorts table, we want a DataTable with cohorts as rows and metric values as columns. For the evolution graph, we just want metric values by cohort, so we don't need to do any extra transformation there.
